title: rhamnus californica subsp. occidentalis
intro: Rhamnus californica subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as California buckthorn or Western coastal buckthorn, is a plant species native to the Pacific coast of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of California buckthorn include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus californica subsp. occidentalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
